verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a knowledge-base app, but the evidence documents no natural-language command interface or AI assistant in Logseq. Slash commands, simple text queries, the logseq:// protocol and the local HTTP API are structured syntax or developer building blocks, not natural-language operation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
